constitution: Spec is the source of truth — code serves the spec, not the reverse.
Every phase is gated — no phase advances on unverified assumptions.
Independent work runs in parallel; dependent work runs in order.
Verification precedes judgment; judgment precedes shipping.
Evidence-based memory — only what actually happened is remembered.
No secrets in code; security is reviewed, never assumed.

tasks.goal: Research prior art, popular solutions, and expected/standard features for: a rock-paper-scissors game vs computer. Surface user needs, not just the literal ask.
Write requirements (what & why) grounded in the findings — include the table-stakes features users expect
Basic design: architecture, data model, interfaces
Detailed design: decompose into ordered testable tasks
Write & run the test suite against requirements
Adversarially self-critique against findings & spec: run critic checklist + lessons. Any gap => demand REWORK before judgment
Judge against spec, findings, critique & constitution: SHIP / REWORK / BLOCK
